name: orbit-carousel
title: Orbit Carousel
description: A team carousel where eight round avatars sit on a circle around a centred profile card. Stepping with the arrows, or clicking an avatar, swings the ring around with a springy overshoot and swaps the card.
use: A team or community page wants a memorable way to browse several people one at a time.
avoid: It uses fixed pixel sizes and a window-width check, so it does not really scale with its container.
a11y: Portraits are clickable images, not buttons, so they cannot be focused or opened from the keyboard; arrows work only globally. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A faint circle on black ringed by eight circular portraits, one edged in indigo. In the middle a small rounded card shows a larger photo overlapping its top edge, a bold name, a role and email in grey, and two chevrons either side of a purple Connect pill.
behaves: Pressing an arrow or clicking a portrait rotates every avatar around the circle with a bouncy spring, and the card fades out and back in with the new person's details. The active portrait keeps its photo upright and carries an indigo ring.
customise: Pass a people array of name, role, email and photo; the ring radius, profile size and spring are fixed, and the Connect button does nothing unless you wire it.
weight: light: Eight avatars rotating with CSS transforms plus one card cross-fade.
